propositions: Residual prose uses of 'Success Criteria' vocabulary must be migrated to 'Acceptance Criteria' in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl

A deterministic repository-scoped guard script must enforce case-insensitive matching of 'Success Criteria' and bare tokens 'SC'/'SCs' with a tab-delimited allowlist that pins exact match counts per path and fails on count drift or malformed entries
The guard must be integrated into the root Makefile lint target so that local and CI checks are identical and catch unallowlisted vocabulary injection

Four permanent semantic carve-outs must be preserved and allowlisted at their documented counts: T2 experiment language, definition-of-done concept citations, migration/lifecycle test probes, and captured Jira fixtures
O-RAN-SC byte sequences in four ADR and workflow files must remain byte-identical to commit a475e24fc9c6edb2c52afc06677803386f45899c and excluded from bare-token scanning
Happy-path acceptance requires zero deprecated vocabulary outside the allowlist across the migrated tree, all acceptance criteria checked, and full pytest/make lint/make typecheck suite passing
